content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: BEL has announced 14 vacancies for the post of Project Engineer, to be posted across five locations in Rajasthan and Gujarat. Posting locations: Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, Jamnagar, Bhuj, Naliya. The notification also states that the number of posts indicated may vary based on the actual requirement at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification, experience, and age criteria described below to be eligible for this recruitment. Candidates must hold a B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc. Engineering degree (4-year course) from an AICTE-approved college/institute or a recognised university, with a Pass Class, in one of the following disciplines: Electronics stream: Electronics / Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Telecommunication / Telecommunication / Communication / Electrical & Electronics. Computer Science stream: Computer Science / Information Technology / Information Science. Candidates need a minimum of 2 years of relevant post-qualification industrial work experience as on 01.07.2026. Experience in the following areas is preferred: IT Infrastructure Projects IP Networking Data Centre Projects CCTV Projects Sensor-based IoT Projects Any IP-enabled electronic/software product installation, configuration, maintenance, or product support services Teaching experience will not be considered as relevant experience. The relevance of experience and the final decision on candidate selection rests with the Selection Committee. The upper age limit for Project Engineer as on 01.07.2026 is 32 years for General category candidates. Age relaxation is available as follows: The maximum permissible age, after considering all applicable relaxations, is 50 years. SSLC/SSC/ISC mark card or any other valid document will be accepted as proof of date of birth.

rows.age_relaxation: 10 years, in addition to the relaxation applicable to their other category, if any
As per Government of India guidelines

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer Salary Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Project Engineers are engaged on a consolidated remuneration basis that increases each year, along with additional benefits. Additional benefits: Area allowance at 10% of the consolidated remuneration per month - applicable only to candidates posted at various sites/customer locations. Rs. 12,000 per year towards insurance premium, attire allowance, stitching charges, footwear allowance, etc. Tenure: Project Engineer-I is initially engaged for a period of 3 years, which may be extended by one more year based on project requirement and individual performance. Retention Bonus: Project Engineer-I candidates who complete an overall tenure of 4 years are entitled to a Retention Bonus of Rs. 25,000 for every completed year, payable at the end of 4 years - i.e., a total of Rs. 1,00,000.

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Application fee must be paid through SBI Collect, either online or by visiting an SBI branch. No cheque, demand draft, or cash will be accepted. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Go to onlinesbi.sbi and select "State Bank Collect". Accept the Terms and Conditions and click "Proceed". Select the state of Corporation/Institution as "All India". Select the type of Corporation/Institution as "PSU - Public Sector Undertaking" and click "Go". Select "Bharat Electronics Limited" under PSU - Public Sector Undertaking and click "Submit". Select the payment category "Project Engineer Raj/Guj Walk In". Complete the payment as per the instructions shown. Take a print of the payment receipt and attach it with the application form. Candidates must ensure they enter the same mobile number and email ID in SBI Collect as mentioned in their application form.

rows.exemption: SC, ST, PwBD categories and Ex-servicemen are exempted from payment of application fee

content_sections.heading: BEL Project Engineer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through a walk-in process for pre-registered candidates only. Candidates must pre-register for the walk-in selection through the official QR code by 09:00 AM on 11.08.2026. Those who do not register will not be allowed to participate. The selection process starts at 08:00 AM; no candidate is allowed entry after 08:30 AM. Selection consists of a written test followed by an interview. Based on the written test score, candidates are shortlisted for interview in the ratio of 1:5 in each category, in order of merit. No travelling expenses/allowance will be given for attending the walk-in selection. Candidates may be required to stay for an additional day for the selection process. Assessment weightage is 85% for the written test and 15% for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for BEL Project Engineer Walk-In Selection
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the original documents along with one self-attested photocopy of each, in the following sequence: Duly filled-in application form 2 recent passport-size photographs Self-attested copy of SSLC/Matriculation Certificate (proof of age) Self-attested copy of PUC/12th Class/Diploma Marks Card Self-attested copies of Degree Marks Card(s) for all semesters/years passed Self-attested copies of Provisional/Final Degree Certificate(s) CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula certificate, duly certified by the university/institution, wherever applicable Self-attested copy of Community/Caste Certificate (for OBC-NCL/SC/ST candidates claiming fee exemption) Self-attested copy of Disability Certificate (for PwBD candidates, in the format available on the BEL website) Post-qualification experience certificate(s) from previous and current employers, with joining/appointment letter and relieving letter to establish years of experience No Objection Certificate (for candidates working in PSUs/Government/Quasi-Government organisations) SBI fee payment receipt (if applicable) A write-up of roles, responsibilities, and experience Updated resume Any other relevant certificates Failure to bring the specified enclosures will result in disqualification, even if the application fee has been paid. Incomplete applications, or those without required enclosures, will be rejected without assigning reasons, and applications sent by email or any other channel will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEL Project Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL), Panchkula, for 14 temporary Project Engineer posts to be based at sites in Rajasthan and Gujarat, filled through a walk-in selection process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under BEL Project Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies for the post of Project Engineer, distributed as UR-4, EWS-1, OBC-4, SC-1, and ST-4.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to register for the BEL Project Engineer walk-in selection?
faq.answer: Candidates must pre-register through the official QR code by 09:00 AM on 11.08.2026. Note that the notification lists two different dates for the walk-in selection itself (05.08.2026 and 11.08.2026) — candidates should verify the correct date on the official BEL website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for BEL Project Engineer?
faq.answer: A B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc. Engineering degree (4-year course) with a Pass Class in Electronics or Computer Science related disciplines, from an AICTE-approved institute or recognised university, along with a minimum of 2 years of relevant post-qualification industrial experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for BEL Project Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for General category candidates as on 01.07.2026, with relaxation of 3 years for OBC-NCL, 5 years for SC/ST, and an additional 10 years for PwBD candidates with 40% or more disability, subject to a maximum permissible age of 50 years.
